description: This source file contains functions to serialize a complex configuration object for a 5G DU high-level system into YAML format. It includes multiple static helper functions to build YAML nodes for various configuration sections, such as metrics, logging, tracing, cell configurations, and protocol parameters. The main function 'fill_du_high_config_in_yaml_schema' populates a YAML node with the entire configuration, including metrics, loggers, trace, metrics, pcap, and cell slices.
